answer: Fingerprints are counted in orchard, thus the distribution is public, and timber lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a reef header, so 2871 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. The deposit is 68 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
